title: SignalFlow Workflow Node Contract
description: The data contract for every node in src/data/workflowNodes.json. Derived from NODE_AUDIT.md. The app renders the selected-node panel and lesson intent from these fields instead of hardcoded assumptions. This schema documents the shape; it is not enforced at runtime.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier, unique across the map. Referenced by edges, phases, and progress.

label.description: Human-readable node name shown on the map and panel.

thingOrAction.description: Doctrine taxonomy rule: a node should be a thing (object) or an action (step). 'ambiguous' flags a node that needs to be renamed or split (e.g. Distribution / Archive).

phaseId.description: The phase this node belongs to (must match an id in phases.json).

x.description: Layout x coordinate within the phase band (design pixels).

y.description: Layout y coordinate within the stage (design pixels).

description.description: What this node is, in one or two sentences (the panel's lead paragraph).

lesson.description: The lesson contract. Every node is a lesson; the type and maturity differ. Drives the lesson intent and lesson framing in the panel.

type.description: The active lesson type. Inspection: examine origin, contents, access, and place in the workflow. Interpretation: read a human/unstructured signal and map it to a structured field. Build: produce a new structured artifact from messy input. Transformation: normalize/compare/apply rules to existing data to emit a derived result. Decision: encode a branch/threshold and route the workflow. Handoff: move work across a human/system boundary and capture the record. Assembly: join multiple artifacts into one deliverable. Governance: define/version/approve reusable rules, policies, and templates.

status.description: Interaction maturity, separate from lesson type. 'now' = fully interactive today; 'intent' = lesson type and learner action defined, interaction not yet built; 'later' = future interaction to be built in a later pass.

intent.description: The lesson intent: the concrete action the learner performs in this lesson (the 'what you'll do').

concepts.description: The automation concepts this lesson introduces.

labVersion.description: What the app simulates locally instead of the real-world system.

realWorldSources.description: Where this node's input/output really comes from at work.

accessNeeded.description: Access, permissions, subscriptions, or agreements a real implementation would require.

soloRebuildPath.description: Step-by-step path for a solo builder to recreate this node, from local fixture to real integration.

reusedBy.description: Node ids that reuse this node's output. Mirrors the downstream edges; kept for convenience.

governanceNote.description: Ownership, access, data quality, approval, auditability, or reuse concern for this node (learner-facing).

auditNote.description: Authoring metadata from NODE_AUDIT.md: the open question or design risk for this node. Not shown to learners.

taskId.description: The lesson/task that completes this node, or null. Must be present in App's LESSONS and progress.BUILT_LESSON_IDS to be buildable now.

artifactName.description: The reusable artifact filename this node produces, or null if it produces none.
